title: triticum durum var. leucura
intro: Triticum durum var. leucura, commonly known as emmer wheat, is an ancient type of wheat that is native to the Mediterranean region. It is known for its high nutritional value and has been used for centuries for its health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and provide a rich source of fiber, iron, and other essential minerals. The therapeutic actions of emmer wheat include its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and improve symptoms associated with conditions such as arthritis and irritable bowel syndrome. The bioactive constituents of emmer wheat include various phenolic compounds, such as ferulic acid and sinapic acid, as well as dietary fiber, which contribute to its health-promoting effects.
